definitions.explanation: Flour made from ground wheat, used in baking and cooking.

examples.japanese: {小麦粉|こむぎこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ふるい→ふるい：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.notes: ふるいにかける means to sift

examples.japanese: ⟦{唐揚|からあ}げ→唐揚げ：04949_karaage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{小麦粉|こむぎこ}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{片栗粉|かたくりこ}→片栗粉：04923_katakuriko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}います→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: To make fried chicken, you use either wheat flour or potato starch.

examples.japanese: {小麦粉|こむぎこ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜて→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Mix flour and water to make dough.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{衣|ころも}→衣：14162_koromo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{小麦粉|こむぎこ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{冷水|れいすい}→冷水：22480_reisui⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Tempura batter is made with wheat flour and cold water.

examples.japanese: {小麦粉|こむぎこ}⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{米粉|こめこ}→米粉：13771_komeko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{売|う}られている→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: Since more people have wheat flour allergies, bread made with rice flour is also sold.

notes:
{小麦粉|こむぎこ} is the general term for flour made from wheat. It is the most common type of flour used in Japanese cooking.

WORD FORMATION:
⟦{小麦|こむぎ}→小麦：01407_komugi⟧ (wheat) + ⟦{粉|こ}→粉：02766_kona⟧ (powder, flour)

TYPES OF WHEAT FLOUR:
- ⟦{薄力粉|はくりきこ}→薄力粉：20705_hakurikiko⟧: cake flour (low gluten — for cakes, tempura)
- ⟦{中力粉|ちゅうりきこ}→中力粉：28725_chuurikiko⟧: all-purpose flour (medium gluten — for udon)
- ⟦{強力粉|きょうりきこ}→強力粉：20706_kyourikiko⟧: bread flour (high gluten — for bread)

COMMON USES:
- ⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧: tempura batter
- ⟦お{好|この}み{焼|や}き→お好み焼き：10252_okonomiyaki⟧: okonomiyaki
- ⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧: udon noodles
- ⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧: bread

RELATED:
- ⟦{片栗粉|かたくりこ}→片栗粉：04923_katakuriko⟧: potato starch (used for frying, thickening)
- ⟦{米粉|こめこ}→米粉：13771_komeko⟧: rice flour (gluten-free alternative)
